@amplitude/analytics-browser.reason: Amplitude SDK phones home. Any package in the @amplitude/* scope is included unless explicitly opted-out via the SDK's opt-out API, which we never call.

@google-analytics/analytics-js.reason: Google Analytics JS SDK. Any package in the @google-analytics/* scope is included for the same reason as the @amplitude/* scope.

@sentry/browser.reason: Sentry browser SDK uploads stack traces and session replays to Sentry's servers. We deliberately do not use Sentry.

@sentry/node.reason: Sentry Node SDK uploads stack traces to Sentry's servers. We deliberately do not use Sentry.

@vercel/analytics.reason: Vercel Web Analytics ships a script tag and POSTs page views to vercel-insights.com. We don't deploy to Vercel and we don't want analytics.

amplitude-js.reason: Legacy Amplitude SDK. Phones home on every page load.

fullstory.reason: FullStory SDK records session replays and sends them to fullstory.com. We never opt in.

hotjar.reason: Hotjar SDK records heatmaps and session replays. Sends to hotjar.com.

mixpanel.reason: Mixpanel Node SDK (server-side). Phones home on every track() call.

mixpanel-browser.reason: Mixpanel browser SDK. Phones home on every event.

posthog-js.reason: PostHog browser SDK. Phones home on every event capture and page view.

posthog-node.reason: PostHog Node SDK. Same phone-home behavior as posthog-js but server-side.

react-ga.reason: react-ga is a Google Analytics wrapper. Phones home on every page view / event.

react-ga4.reason: react-ga4 is the GA4 wrapper. Same phone-home behavior as react-ga.
